notes_en:
• Updates now download by themselves. Press "Restart now" at the bottom – or the update installs when you close the app.
• A clear "What's new" list for every update.
• Printer cards from the dashboard: each print type prints on its card's printer.
• Print quality Draft / Normal / High for each card.
• Both sides by hand ("Manual flip") for printers without automatic both-sides printing.
• Borderless photos (when the printer has a borderless paper size).
• Printer status and ink levels (network printers) shown in the dashboard.
• New order alert: 8 tones, ring 1 / 3 / 5 / 10 times or until accepted.
